releases.body:
### Added

- `windows.scenario: "reminder"` keeps a Windows or WSL toast on screen until you dismiss it (#154; issue #153).

### Upgrade notes

- Nothing changes unless you set `windows.scenario` to `"reminder"`. Reminder toasts do not run `focusOnClick` or `onClickCommand`, and the final reminder script has not been run on Windows or WSL yet, so please report how it behaves.
- A reminder adds a per-user `HKCU\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId\<appID>` key when that ID is not registered yet; the plugin never removes it, so delete it if you stop using the option.

### Contributors

- Thanks to @NGC13009 for proposing and implementing Windows reminder toasts in #154.

### Fixed

- On WSL, toasts now work right after a fresh install or update, without a manual `chmod +x` on node-notifier's snoreToast executable (#152; issue #151).

### Upgrade notes

- Nothing changes outside WSL. `1.1.3` and `1.1.3-beta.0` contain the same implementation and differ only in the package version.

### Contributors

- Thanks to @cardin for reporting and fixing the WSL toast issue in #152.

### Fixed

- On WSL, toasts now work right after a fresh install or update, without a manual `chmod +x` on node-notifier's snoreToast executable (#152; issue #151).

### Contributors

- Thanks to @cardin for reporting and fixing the WSL toast issue in #152.

### Fixed

- On OpenCode 2, a terminal whose config turns off every channel for an event no longer claims it, so another terminal on the same machine can still alert (#149; issue #147).
- Over SSH on Linux, an active tmux or Zellij pane no longer mutes alerts when no desktop window can be checked, so bells reach a terminal tab that is in the background (#149; issue #147).

### Upgrade notes

- Local sessions and SSH sessions with a detected desktop window keep the same focus behavior. Over SSH inside tmux or Zellij with no detected desktop window, alerts now fire even while you are looking at the pane.
- `1.1.2` and `1.1.2-beta.0` contain the same implementation and differ only in the package version.
